SELECT f."NSLP Provision Status", s.State, COUNT(*) AS magnet_schools, COUNT(t.cds) AS schools_with_sat, COUNT(DISTINCT s.County) AS counties
FROM main.frpm AS f
JOIN main.schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN main.satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
GROUP BY f."NSLP Provision Status", s.State

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    s.County AS county_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(t.NumTstTakr), 0) AS total_sat_test_takers
FROM main.schools AS s
JOIN main.frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN main.satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
  AND s.Magnet = 1
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2'
GROUP BY s.County
LIMIT 1000
